architecture_layers.name: Strategy & Ideation
architecture_layers.description: Deconstructs business problem, unearths consumer tensions, benchmarks against 571 campaigns, and generates Cannes-calibrated concepts.

architecture_layers.name: Visual Architecture & Representation
architecture_layers.description: Establishes narrative arcs, spatial hierarchy, typography, native RTL eye flow, and anti-bias human representation.

architecture_layers.name: Brand Identity & Taste Intelligence
architecture_layers.description: Audits brand assets, enforces logo clearspace, and extracts evidence-backed transferable aesthetic rules.

architecture_layers.name: Craft Physics & Optics
architecture_layers.description: Directs camera focal length, 3-point lighting systems, melanin-accurate color grading, and compositing contact physics.

architecture_layers.name: Sanitization & Model Compilation
architecture_layers.description: Normalizes annotation-guided edits into bounded contracts and compiles approved art direction into provider instructions.

architecture_layers.name: Verification & QA Release Gates
architecture_layers.description: Independent release gate enforcing category floors, 7-point representation review, AI-slop vetoes, and targeted revision routing.

feedback_loops.name: cannes_ideation_refinement_loop
feedback_loops.action: Rotate structural method in methods-catalog (SIT -> Bisociation -> Inversion), refine underlying tension, and re-score (up to 5 passes).

feedback_loops.name: craft_physics_alignment_loop
feedback_loops.action: Realign horizon lines, key light angles, and color temperatures between composite elements and background plate.

feedback_loops.name: bounded_edit_containment_loop
feedback_loops.action: Reject output, reset to approved source checkpoint, shrink mutation polygon, and reissue EditContract.

feedback_loops.name: arabic_glyph_integrity_loop
feedback_loops.action: Issue hard veto, extract exact Unicode string, verify ligature shaping, and inject strict typographic constraints into prompt-compiler.

feedback_loops.name: anti_bias_representation_loop
feedback_loops.action: Inject explicit facial bone structure variance, melanin-calibrated lighting spec, and negative constraints against generic stock archetypes.

verification_gates.name: Intake & Brief Invariants
verification_gates.criteria: Task type, primary communication job, deliverables, and immutable client locks established.

verification_gates.name: Ideation & Originality
verification_gates.criteria: Cannes weighted score >= 8.5, Pollard taxonomy matched, pattern saturation capped at 6.0 for P09/P11/P16 without structural novelty.

verification_gates.name: Representation & Inclusivity
verification_gates.criteria: Passes 7-point representation checklist, no clone faces, melanin-calibrated lighting, no gibberish cultural symbols.

verification_gates.name: Spatial & Typographic Preflight
verification_gates.criteria: 1-second thumbnail test passes, grayscale value mass clear, exact copy locked, Arabic glyphs shaped.

verification_gates.name: Craft Realism & Physics
verification_gates.criteria: Consistent horizon, ambient occlusion contact shadows, directional reflections, and physical light wrap.

verification_gates.name: Bounded-Edit Containment
verification_gates.criteria: Mutation budget = 1, protected complement locked, approved source checkpoint verified.

verification_gates.name: Post-Generation Visual Signoff
verification_gates.criteria: Weighted score >= 92, all applicable category floors met, AI-slop veto clear, collateral drift zero.

designly-director.description: Brief intake, routing, conflict resolution, lock enforcement, and final approval.

creative-strategy.description: Objective, audience, message hierarchy, and visual concept territory.

creative-director.description: Cannes-calibrated ideation, structural concept generation (SIT/TRIZ/Bisociation), 7-level idea taxonomy, and multi-round recursive refinement.

insight-mining.description: Consumer tension spotting (cultural, category, human), JTBD, Mark Pollard Four Points, and insight synthesis.

campaign-canon.description: 571 canonical advertising campaigns, P01-P18 pattern taxonomy, anti-derivative benchmarking, and saturation caps.

brand-activation.description: Experiential campaigns, PR stunts, brand utility, cultural objects, and non-advertising diagnostics.

visual-storytelling.description: Narrative architecture, 6 storytelling frameworks (Story Spine, Sparkline, Freytag, Monroe), and emotional tiers.

brand-intelligence.description: Brand rules, observed patterns, brand-off test, and product/logo fidelity.

taste-engine.description: Reference deconstruction, evidence-backed transferable rules, anti-rules, and taste mixing.

reference-memory.description: Stable REF IDs, scoped likes/dislikes ledger, and preference recall.

composition-director.description: Grid, hierarchy, focal structure, grouping, negative space, crop, and eye path.

typography-director.description: Type hierarchy, text zones, line breaks, measure, spacing, and exact-copy strategy.

photography-director.description: Camera logic, lighting, lens behavior, materials, realism, and subject treatment.

manipulation-director.description: Compositing, perspective, scale, contact, reflections, relighting, and occlusion.

arabic-rtl-director.description: Arabic-first composition, RTL reading flow, glyph correctness, and mixed Arabic/English behavior.

campaign-dna.description: Multi-asset continuity, visual-family rules, and deliberate variation.

edit-sanitizer.description: Normalizes annotation-guided edits into a bounded EditContract and blocks ambiguous, over-broad, or drift-prone revisions before image execution.

prompt-compiler.description: Compiles approved Art Direction Spec or sanitized EditContract into provider/model-ready generation or edit instructions.

visual-qa.description: Post-generation critique, hard gates, category floors, anti-slop veto, and collateral-change review for bounded edits.
